purpose: Govern the distinction between the certified canonical Pre-Collector product universe and model-specific training eligibility without introducing arbitrary age or vintage exclusions.

canonical_universe_boundary.rule: Model eligibility decisions do not alter canonical universe membership. A canonical product remains part of the governed Pre-Collector universe unless a separate scope-governance change is owner-approved and recertified.

governing_principles.default_rule: Do not exclude, down-weight, or isolate a canonical product solely because it is old, expensive, scarce, or inconvenient for a candidate model.
governing_principles.evidence_rule: Model-specific treatment must be justified by governed empirical evidence drawn from pricing history, data coverage, availability, liquidity, scarcity behavior, statistical influence, stability, and out-of-sample performance.
governing_principles.anti_cherry_picking_rule: A product must not be excluded merely because removing it improves a preferred model metric after results are observed.
governing_principles.cross_model_rule: Where practical, exclusion or reduced-influence findings must be tested across multiple candidate model families, validation folds or windows, and required forecast horizons before permanent model treatment is owner-approved.
governing_principles.collector_alignment_rule: Pre-Collector forecasting should preserve Collector-lane principles for certified pricing authority, historical evidence, availability and liquidity evidence, comparable methodology, uncertainty, tournament evaluation, and separation of forecasts from purchase authorization, while allowing additional empirical model-eligibility controls because the Pre-Collector lane spans materially older products.

universe_roles.canonical_universe: Defines which products belong to the governed Pre-Collector lane.
universe_roles.model_eligible_universe: Defines which canonical products may contribute observations to fitting or calibration for a specific model or horizon.
universe_roles.prediction_universe: Defines which canonical products may receive forecasts after the selected model is certified for that product's evidence and applicability profile.
universe_roles.ranking_universe: Defines which forecasted products may enter governed investment ranking after separate downstream authorization.

required_diagnostic_dimensions: price-source agreement and staleness where measurable
statistical leverage, influence, residual behavior, or analogous model-family diagnostics
parameter or prediction stability when the product is included versus diagnostically isolated
out-of-sample performance across governed validation folds or windows
performance across required one-year, three-year, and five-year horizons where applicable
robustness across multiple candidate model families where practical

governance_controls.next_required_stage: Recertify Pre-Collector model-selection architecture against the certified canonical universe and this model-eligibility governance.
governance_controls.change_control: Any change to model-eligibility reason codes, diagnostic requirements, exclusion logic, treatment semantics, or the separation among canonical, training, prediction, and ranking universes requires owner approval, version change, and recertification.

owner_decision_notes: The data must determine whether older or unusual boxes impair model validity; age is not a predeclared exclusion rule.
A difficult observation may remain a valid investment target even when it is unsuitable for fitting a particular model.
Data-quality problems and genuine economic or structural non-comparability must be distinguished in the eligibility ledger.
Model exclusions are governed model decisions, not retroactive edits to the certified 186-product Pre-Collector universe.
